doc.name: Trooth
doc.description: Read any company's record on the Trooth Network, each fact labeled with who said it and when. An A2A agent for three read-only lookups on the Trooth Network: a company's public record, the signatures on a Trust Ledger Token, and a bounded question about Trooth. This card describes this agent's interface only. It is not any company's evidence profile and says nothing about any company; a company's record is what the company_record skill returns, with its own source and date. Anonymous callers get a direct message and nothing is kept; a caller with an OAuth access token for this agent (no scope is required) gets a task it alone can read back for 24 hours.

skills.name: Look up a company's public record
skills.description: Read one company's published record on the Trooth Network, given its domain or Trooth slug, matched exactly. Returns a status, a provenance label and the record's own source and date. The company's own text is labeled as its own words. Read only.

skills.name: Verify a Trust Ledger Token (receipt)
skills.description: Check the two signatures on a Trust Ledger Token (tlt2. or tlt. form, or its JTI) against Trooth's token ledger. Returns valid, invalid, expired, revoked or unclaimed. Trooth's signature covers the signing event, not the truth of the claims. Read only.

skills.name: Ask a bounded question about Trooth
skills.description: Answer a question about Trooth itself (what the Trooth Network is, what a record carries, pricing, how witnessing works) from Trooth's fixed knowledge base, with citations. Questions are capped at 300 characters, and no question text is kept; a question outside the knowledge base answers out_of_scope. Makes no outside request.
examples: What does one company record on Trooth carry?

oauth2SecurityScheme.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code with PKCE from Trooth's authorization server (WorkOS AuthKit). Request the token with resource=https://api.trooth.co/a2a/v1 (RFC 8707). Optional: without it, calls are answered anonymously and nothing is kept. Protected-resource metadata: https://api.trooth.co/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/a2a/v1
